description: Brilliant but sheltered student Flynn Carsen is recruited as the Librarian and immediately discovers that the job means protecting magical artifacts rather than shelving books, beginning with a globe-spanning race for the stolen Spear of Destiny.

s00e01.description: Flynn Carsen becomes guardian of a hidden collection of dangerous artifacts and is thrown into his first field mission when the Serpent Brotherhood steals part of the Spear of Destiny, forcing him and Guardian Nicole Noone to pursue the remaining pieces before the weapon can be reassembled.
